title: Claude Code LLM spans must be emitted per logical assistant message, not per JSONL entry
answers: Claude Code trace is missing token usage or cost for tool-call-only messages
Claude Code tracing shows no LLM span for thinking-only assistant turns
Split Claude Code assistant message undercounts tokens and cost in MLflow trace
body:
Symptom: In MLflow traces of Claude Code sessions, assistant turns that only call tools or only contain thinking show no token usage or cost, and a message split across several transcript lines is undercounted.
Root cause: libs/typescript/integrations/claude-code/src/tracing.ts:createLlmAndToolSpans created the LLM span only when the entry had non-empty text and no tool_use, so tool-only and thinking-only entries produced no usage or cost.
Fix pattern: Build one logical message per message.id with getLogicalAssistantMessage (concatenate content, field-merge usage, keep the first known model), create one LLM span per message key via emittedLlmMessageKeys, and still emit one tool span per tool_use block from the original entry.
Constraints: Coalesce only by message.id; entries without an id stay independent (keyed by transcript index). Do not sum usage fields, because Claude Code repeats the full per-message usage on split entries and summing double counts. Skip progress rows while coalescing but break on any other non-assistant entry such as user, so separate turns that reuse an id are not merged.
applies: Claude Code transcript parsing in libs/typescript/integrations/claude-code; the Python tracer in mlflow/claude_code is not changed by this change.
says: Traces omit token usage and cost metrics when an assistant turn only calls tools.
Thinking steps without text output fail to show model spans or expenses in traces.
Split assistant responses undercount total token consumption and calculated cost in session traces.
Tool-only assistant turns should display model execution spans with recorded token counts.
Ensure multi-part assistant messages report complete token usage without double counting.
search: In libs/typescript/integrations/claude-code/src/tracing.ts, LLM spans must be emitted per logical assistant message via getLogicalAssistantMessage and emittedLlmMessageKeys rather than per JSONL entry. This ensures tool-only and thinking-only entries generate LLM spans with accurate token usage and costs, while preserving tool spans per tool_use block. Coalescing merges usage fields by message.id without summing, skips progress rows, breaks on non-assistant entries like user, and leaves mlflow/claude_code unchanged.
